# Product Comparison

`comparison/product-comparison` &middot; section-level &middot; category: comparison

## Purpose

Two to four products side by side: photo, name and price on top, spec rows, and a button under each.

## Required fields

| Field | Type | Default |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `products` | list of object { name, price, image, highlight, cta } (2 to 4) |  |
| `rows` | list of object { label, values } (1 to 20) |  |

## Optional fields

| Field | Type | Default |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `heading` | text |  |
| `intro` | text |  |

## Variants

Same data and structure, different styling. Pick one with `{ variant: 'name' }`.

- **default**: Products with hairline spec rows.
- **zebra**: Alternating row shading. Sets `tableVariant: zebra`.

## Settings

Every setting has a default. Values may be token references (`@colors.accent`, `@theme.card.radius`). Pass overrides with `{ settings: { ... } }`.

| Setting | Type | Default |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `hideOnMobile` | boolean | `false` |
| `hideOnDesktop` | boolean | `false` |
| `tableVariant` | one of `default`, `zebra`, `tinted` | `"default"` |

## Responsive behavior

- `hideOnMobile`: hides it below 480px. Outlook desktop and Gmail on non-Google accounts ignore media queries and still show it.
- `hideOnDesktop`: shows it only on phones. Clients that ignore media queries keep it hidden.

## Compatibility

| Outlook desktop | Gmail apps | Dark mode |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Tables, images and borders honored. | Fine. Columns shrink on phones. | Cells on the surface or background swap via dm-* classes. Images are not recolored. |



## Example usage

This is a section-level component: use it directly in an email body or a recipe.

In an email (`.mjml`):

```
[[ c('comparison/product-comparison', {
  "heading": "Which linen shirt is right for you?",
  "products": [
    {
      "name": "Coastal",
      "price": "$120",
      "image": {
        "src": "https://placehold.co/128x128/png?text=Coastal",
        "alt": "The Coastal shirt in sand"
      },
      "cta": {
        "label": "Shop",
        "href": "https://example.com/products/coastal"
      }
    },
    {
      "name": "Harbour",
      "price": "$135",
      "image": {
        "src": "https://placehold.co/128x128/png?text=Harbour",
        "alt": "The Harbour shirt in navy"
      },
      "highlight": true,
      "cta": {
        "label": "Shop",
        "href": "https://example.com/products/harbour"
      }
    },
    {
      "name": "Dune",
      "price": "$110",
      "image": {
        "src": "https://placehold.co/128x128/png?text=Dune",
        "alt": "The Dune shirt in white"
      },
      "cta": {
        "label": "Shop",
        "href": "https://example.com/products/dune"
      }
    }
  ],
  "rows": [
    {
      "label": "Fit",
      "values": [
        "Relaxed",
        "Regular",
        "Boxy"
      ]
    },
    {
      "label": "Weight",
      "values": [
        "150 gsm",
        "180 gsm",
        "150 gsm"
      ]
    },
    {
      "label": "Pre-washed",
      "values": [
        "yes",
        "yes",
        "no"
      ]
    },
    {
      "label": "Best for",
      "values": [
        "Hot days",
        "Every day",
        "Layering"
      ]
    }
  ]
}) ]]
```
